title: problem.json
description: Manifest for one problem. Lives at the root of a week-N/ directory and marks that directory as a problem.

schema_version.description: Manifest format version. Bumped only by a breaking change to this schema.

id.description: Stable problem identifier. Must equal the name of the directory holding this file.

title.description: Human-readable name shown in the catalog.

category.description: Category id. Must be declared in content/config.json.

difficulty.description: Relative difficulty, used for filtering in the catalog.

languages.description: Languages this problem accepts. Each one needs a srcs/<lang>/ scaffold and a solutions/<lang>/ reference solution.

fixture.description: Name of the regtest snapshot restored before the run phase.

services.description: Bitcoin services attached to the job network. bitcoind is always on.

limits.description: Per-job ceilings for the run phase. The build phase timeout is a runner constant, not a per-problem field.

wall_sec.description: Wall-clock ceiling for validation.sh, enforced by the runner.

memory_mb.description: Memory cap for the user container.
